data.title: 圣路易斯 · 晚霞沙滩的落日比基尼余晖
data.description: 黄昏的火红晚霞浸染了整片热带海岸，金色海浪涌上细软白沙。圣路易斯身穿一袭绚丽的落日色挂脖比基尼，赤足漫步在浅浪中。水花溅湿了她冰蓝色的长发末端，夕照在她起伏优美的轮廓与白皙皮肤上镀上一层绚丽的流光。她转过头来伸手相邀，嘴角泛起让人心醉神迷的迷人笑靥。
data.action: standing in shallow shoreline waves at golden sunset, sunset gradient halter bikini, wet blue hair tips, holding out hand to viewer, breathtaking seductive smile

data.mood: intense romantic sunset grandeur, irresistible coastal allure
data.promptProse: Standing in gentle shore waves as the ocean glows in fiery sunset hues, St. Louis wears a vibrant sunset bikini. She extends a welcoming hand, her blue hair drifting in the warm sea breeze with a captivating, sun-kissed smile.
data.animaCaption: St. Louis standing in ocean waves at sunset in a vibrant bikini, reaching out a hand.
